controls.title: Ensure external content sharing is restricted
controls.description: Tenant sharing capability must be no more permissive than existing guests.
controls.rationale: Anonymous sharing links leave the tenant's control the moment they are created and are indexable if forwarded.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will no longer be able to create anyone-with-the-link sharing links.

assertions.failure: SharePoint sharing capability is {actual}; anonymous links can be created.
assertions.hint: Run Set-SPOTenant -SharingCapability ExistingExternalUserSharingOnly (or Disabled if no external collaboration is required).

remediation.name: Restrict external content sharing
remediation.payload:
Set-SPOTenant -SharingCapability ExistingExternalUserSharingOnly
Get-SPOTenant | Select-Object SharingCapability | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure that SharePoint guest users cannot share items they don't own
controls.description: Guests must be prevented from re-sharing content they do not own.
controls.rationale: Re-sharing by guests extends access to people the data owner never approved and never sees.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Guests will no longer be able to re-share files.

assertions.failure: Guests can re-share content they do not own (PreventExternalUsersFromResharing is {actual}).

controls.title: Ensure link sharing is restricted in SharePoint and OneDrive
controls.description: The default sharing link must be scoped to people in the organisation, with view permission.
controls.rationale: The default link type is what most users accept without thinking, so it has to be the safe option.
controls.userImpact: Impact: New links default to internal, view-only; users can still widen a link deliberately.

audit.name: Read the default sharing link configuration

assertions.failure: The default sharing link type is {actual}; CIS requires {expected}.
The default link permission is {actual}; CIS requires {expected}.

remediation.name: Default new links to internal, view-only
remediation.payload:
Set-SPOTenant -DefaultSharingLinkType Internal -DefaultLinkPermission View
Get-SPOTenant | Select-Object DefaultSharingLinkType, DefaultLinkPermission | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous link defaults
rollback.payload:
Set-SPOTenant -DefaultSharingLinkType {{DefaultSharingLinkType}} -DefaultLinkPermission {{DefaultLinkPermission}}
Get-SPOTenant | Select-Object DefaultSharingLinkType, DefaultLinkPermission | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure guest access to a site or OneDrive will expire automatically
controls.description: Guest access must expire after no more than 30 days.
controls.rationale: Guest accounts routinely outlive the project that created them, leaving standing external access nobody reviews.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Guests will lose access after the expiry window unless it is extended.

assertions.failure: Guest access expires after {actual} days; CIS requires no more than {expected}.

remediation.name: Expire guest access after 30 days
remediation.payload:
Set-SPOTenant -ExternalUserExpirationRequired $true -ExternalUserExpireInDays 30
Get-SPOTenant | Select-Object ExternalUserExpirationRequired, ExternalUserExpireInDays | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous guest expiry configuration
rollback.payload:
Set-SPOTenant -ExternalUserExpirationRequired {{ExternalUserExpirationRequired}} -ExternalUserExpireInDays {{ExternalUserExpireInDays}}
Get-SPOTenant | Select-Object ExternalUserExpirationRequired, ExternalUserExpireInDays | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure custom script execution is restricted on personal sites
controls.description: Users must not be able to run custom script on OneDrive and personal sites.
controls.rationale: Custom script on a personal site is arbitrary code execution in the tenant's own origin.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Pages relying on custom script will stop rendering that script.
controls.cisControl: CIS Control 2: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
controls.nistCategory: PR.PS-05 Installation of unauthorized software is prevented

assertions.failure: Custom script execution is permitted on personal sites ({actual}).

remediation.name: Block custom script on personal sites

rollback.name: Restore the previous custom script setting
